intro_text.en: Bilingual teaching notes with construction, working, applications and revision. Exam has questions only. Use supervised models; no actual practical is claimed.
intro_text.gu: English technical keywords સાથે સરળ ગુજરાતી સમજ. Construction, working, applications અને revision. Exam માં માત્ર પ્રશ્નો. Supervised model વાપરો; actual practical નો દાવો નથી.

h.gu: 5.1.1 IC અને EC Engine નો ફરક

body.en:
An internal combustion (IC) engine releases fuel energy by combustion within the working-fluid space of the engine, and high-pressure gases produce mechanical output. In an external combustion (EC) arrangement, heat is supplied from outside the working-fluid engine, as with a steam engine receiving boiler steam.

Compare location of combustion/heat supply, working fluid, starting arrangement and application. A petrol engine and diesel engine are IC examples. A steam engine is an EC example; the boiler is the steam generator, not the same component as the engine.
body.gu:
IC engine માં engine ની working-fluid space અંદર combustion થાય અને high-pressure gas mechanical output આપે. EC માં working-fluid engine ને heat બહારથી મળે; boiler steam થી ચાલતું steam engine ઉદાહરણ છે.

Combustion location, working fluid, starting અને application સરખાવો. Petrol/diesel IC છે; steam engine EC છે. Boiler steam generator છે, engine એ જ ભાગ નથી.

body.en:
Classify by ignition: spark ignition (SI) and compression ignition (CI); by cycle sequence: two-stroke/four-stroke; by fuel: petrol, diesel or gaseous fuels; by cooling: air/liquid; by cylinders: single/multiple and arrangement; by application: stationary/vehicle and others.

These axes overlap. A conventional four-stroke petrol engine is commonly SI; a conventional diesel is CI. Modern technologies vary, so do not turn common textbook examples into universal fuel/ignition rules.
body.gu:
Ignition પ્રમાણે SI/CI, sequence પ્રમાણે two/four-stroke, fuel પ્રમાણે petrol/diesel/gas, cooling પ્રમાણે air/liquid, cylinders પ્રમાણે single/multi અને application પ્રમાણે stationary/vehicle વર્ગો છે.

Axes overlap થાય છે. Conventional petrol સામાન્ય SI અને diesel CI છે; modern variations હોઈ શકે, એટલે examples ને universal rule ન બનાવો.

body.en:
The cylinder/block guides piston motion; the cylinder head encloses the upper chamber and carries suitable ports/valves. The piston receives gas force; piston rings provide sealing and oil-control functions. The connecting rod joins piston to crankshaft, converting reciprocation into shaft rotation through the crank mechanism.

Crankcase supports/protects mechanisms; bearings guide loaded motion; flywheel stores/releases rotational energy to smooth speed fluctuations. It does not create energy. Gaskets/seals restrict leakage in their specified locations.
body.gu:
Cylinder/block piston ને guide કરે; head chamber બંધ કરે અને ports/valves ધરાવે. Piston gas force લે; rings sealing/oil control કરે. Connecting rod piston ને crankshaft સાથે જોડે અને crank mechanism reciprocation ને rotation માં ફેરવે.

Crankcase support/protection, bearings loaded motion guide અને flywheel rotational energy store/release કરીને speed variation smooth કરે. Flywheel energy બનાવતું નથી.

h.en: 5.2.2 Valves, ignition, injection and supporting systems

body.en:
Inlet/exhaust valves manage charge entry and gas exit in the conventional four-stroke design; camshaft/valve gear times their motion. An SI engine uses a spark plug; a CI engine uses an injector to deliver fuel into hot compressed air. Petrol injection may be port or direct; a diesel injector is not a spark plug.

Cooling controls temperature and lubrication limits friction/wear. A starter supplies initial rotation. The intake/exhaust systems and fuel delivery must suit the design. Do not run an engine indoors or approach hot/rotating parts.
body.gu:
Conventional four-stroke માં inlet/exhaust valves charge entry/exit કરે; camshaft timing આપે. SI માં spark plug; CI માં injector hot compressed air માં fuel આપે. Petrol માં port/direct injection હોઈ શકે; diesel injector spark plug નથી.

Cooling T control કરે, lubrication wear/friction ઘટાડે, starter initial rotation આપે. Engine indoors ન ચલાવો; hot/rotating parts થી દૂર રહો.

body.en:
TDC is the piston position nearest the head; BDC is farthest. A stroke is travel between these positions. A four-stroke cycle requires four piston strokes and two crankshaft revolutions, with one principal power stroke per cylinder per cycle.

The simple textbook valve description uses opening/closing at endpoints. Real valve timing uses advance, delay and overlap; it is not exactly the simplified diagram. No engine numerical is required by this syllabus.
body.gu:
TDC piston head ની નજીક અને BDC દૂરની position. બંને વચ્ચેનું travel stroke છે. Four-stroke cycle માં ચાર strokes અને crankshaft ના બે revolutions; cylinder દીઠ એક principal power stroke.

Textbook માં valves endpoints પર બતાવાય; actual timing માં advance/delay/overlap હોય છે. Syllabus મુજબ engine numericals જરૂરી નથી.

h.en: 5.3.1 Four-stroke petrol engine — intake and compression

body.en:
Intake: piston travels TDC to BDC while the conventional inlet path is open; fresh charge enters. In a simple premixed teaching example air–fuel mixture enters; direct-injection designs may admit air and inject fuel separately.

Compression: piston moves BDC to TDC with valves nominally closed, compressing charge. Near the appropriate timing, a spark initiates combustion. A spark is an ignition trigger, not the source of all the output energy.
body.gu:
Intake: TDC થી BDC piston જાય, inlet path ખુલ્લો હોય અને fresh charge આવે. Simple premixed example માં air–fuel mixture; direct injection માં air/fuel અલગ આવે.

Compression: BDC થી TDC, valves nominally બંધ અને charge compress થાય. યોગ્ય timing પર spark combustion શરૂ કરે; output energy spark માંથી નહીં, fuel માંથી છે.

h.en: 5.3.2 Four-stroke petrol engine — power and exhaust

body.en:
Power: combustion raises gas pressure; expanding gas drives the piston toward BDC and turns the crankshaft through the rod. Valves are nominally closed during the main expansion period.

Exhaust: piston returns toward TDC with the exhaust path open, expelling burned gases. Flywheel/multi-cylinder contributions help carry the mechanism through non-power strokes. This model is for explanation, not ignition/valve adjustment instructions.
body.gu:
Power: combustion થી pressure વધે, expanding gas piston ને BDC તરફ ધકેલે અને rod/crankshaft output આપે. Main expansion માં valves nominally બંધ.

Exhaust: exhaust path open અને piston TDC તરફ જઈ burned gases બહાર કાઢે. Flywheel/multi-cylinder contribution non-power strokes માં motion રાખે. આ adjustment instruction નથી.

h.en: 5.3.3 Four-stroke diesel engine — intake and compression

body.en:
Intake: air enters as the piston descends. Compression: piston rises with valves nominally closed and compresses air, raising its temperature. Conventional diesels generally use higher compression ratios than conventional petrol SI engines.

Fuel is injected near the appropriate end-of-compression period and ignites under suitable hot-air conditions. No spark plug is needed for normal compression ignition. Some engines use glow plugs/heaters for starting aid; they are not timed spark-ignition plugs.
body.gu:
Intake: piston નીચે જાય અને air આવે. Compression: valves nominally બંધ, air compress થતાં T વધે. Conventional diesel માં સામાન્ય petrol SI કરતાં compression ratio વધારે હોય છે.

યોગ્ય end-compression timing નજીક fuel inject થાય અને hot air માં ignite થાય. Normal CI માટે spark plug નથી; glow plug starting aid છે, timed spark plug નહીં.

h.en: 5.3.4 Four-stroke diesel — power, exhaust and comparison

body.en:
Combustion and expansion drive the piston down during the power event; the exhaust event removes products as the piston rises. Actual injection and combustion extend over a finite period and differ from ideal-cycle diagrams.

Compare petrol/diesel by ignition method, usual charge admitted, fuel system, typical compression level, construction/duty and emissions controls. Avoid claims that one engine always has less cost, noise or pollution; load, design and after-treatment matter.
body.gu:
Power event માં combustion/expansion piston નીચે ચલાવે; exhaust event માં ઉપર જઈ products કાઢે. Actual injection/combustion finite time લે છે અને ideal cycle થી જુદા છે.

Ignition, admitted charge, fuel system, સામાન્ય compression, duty અને emission controls પ્રમાણે compare કરો. Cost/noise/pollution દરેક condition માં એકસરખી superiority ધરાવતા નથી.

body.en:
The basic air-standard Otto cycle models heat addition at constant volume; the basic air-standard Diesel cycle models heat addition at constant pressure. Both include idealised compression/expansion and heat-rejection processes. These are thermodynamic models, not literal descriptions of every instant in a real engine.

Do not say real petrol combustion is exactly constant-volume or real diesel combustion exactly constant-pressure. The syllabus requests comparison and no numerical calculation, so focus on model assumptions and differences rather than derivations.
body.gu:
Basic air-standard Otto cycle માં heat addition constant volume અને Diesel cycle માં constant pressure model થાય. બંનેમાં idealised compression/expansion અને heat rejection છે. આ models છે, દરેક actual instant ની exact description નહીં.

Actual petrol combustion exact constant-volume અથવા diesel exact constant-pressure ન લખો. અહીં comparison અને no numericals છે; derivations નહીં.

body.en:
CNG is compressed natural gas, typically methane-rich, stored in certified pressure cylinders and delivered through an approved regulating/fuel system. Suitable engines use a compatible gaseous-fuel arrangement; conversion requires authorised engineering and legal compliance.

Tailpipe pollutants and CO₂ can differ from petrol/diesel under comparable use, but CNG is not pollution-free; methane leakage and emissions-system performance matter. Never alter cylinder valves, pressure regulators or refill equipment.
body.gu:
CNG methane-rich natural gas ને compress કરીને certified cylinders માં રાખે; approved regulator/fuel system થી engine સુધી આપે. Conversion માટે authorised engineering/compliance જોઈએ.

Comparable use માં emissions બદલાય, પણ CNG pollution-free નથી; methane leakage અને controls મહત્વના છે. Cylinder valve/regulator/refill equipment જાતે ન બદલો.

h.en: 5.4.2 EVs — energy path, merits and limits
h.gu: 5.4.2 EVs — Energy Path, લાભ અને મર્યાદા

body.en:
A battery electric vehicle stores electrical energy in a battery; power electronics control a motor that produces wheel torque through the driveline. Regenerative braking can recover part of kinetic energy within battery/traction limits. It does not recover all energy.

Battery EVs have no combustion exhaust at the vehicle, but overall environmental impact depends on electricity supply, manufacturing and use. Range, charging, cost and thermal management require actual specifications. High-voltage battery/drive systems need trained service; do not open packs or touch damaged orange high-voltage cabling.
body.gu:
Battery EV માં battery electrical energy રાખે; power electronics motor control કરે અને driveline થી wheel torque મળે. Regenerative braking થોડું kinetic energy પાછું battery માં આપે; બધું નહીં.

Vehicle પર combustion exhaust નથી, પણ total environmental impact electricity/manufacturing/use પર આધારિત. Range/charging actual specs પરથી. High-voltage pack/cabling trained service માટે છે; pack ખોલવો નહીં.

a.en: No; normally a starting heat aid.
